newsitem.title: POLAND: Swarzedz says errors in early 96 reports.
newsitem.headline: Swarzedz says errors in early 96 reports.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA said on Tuesday an audit and an internal inspection had shown that the law had been breached in preparing the firm's financial reports for the January-April period in 1996.
Swarzedz said in a statement that it had notified a local prosecutors' office about the finding.
"An audit of the 1996 financial report and an internal control have discovered circumstances that point to breaching of the law in the January-April period, 1996," the statement said.
The statement contained no further details and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Swarzedz has said it is forecast to suffer a 4.4 million zloty loss this year on sales of 167.9 million zlotys. In 1996, Swarzedz had 53.9 million zloty loss on sales of 107 million zlotys.
